salesCopy.description: The Dev Concepts Starter Bundle combines Volumes 1 and 2 to give you a comprehensive foundation in software development. Volume 1 covers software craftsmanship, professional mindset, and productivity. Volume 2 teaches client needs, UX design, and requirements discovery. Plus, you get lifetime access to an exclusive Slack community with senior developer mentorship. Perfect for junior developers who want to accelerate their careers with proper guidance and support. Save money versus buying individually while building essential skills.
